verdict.rationale: Ramp's developer docs say a backend can create a card through the Vault API, and the cards guide covers issuing cards and attaching controls. Fund restrictions (amount, interval, merchants, categories, countries) serve as the limit. Card locking is shown only through the MCP and CLI (funds lock), not a documented public API endpoint, and Vault card creation is gated behind Ramp approval. Missing for 10: a documented public API endpoint to lock a card, explicit API reference for updating card controls after issuance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue and manage cards programmatically — create a card with a limit, lock it, update controls — via the public API

citations.quote: Vault API (server-side) — your backend creates a card and retrieves the PAN, CVV, and expiration in one synchronous call.
Issue cards, attach controls, and watch spend in real time
Funds. A budget with restrictions — amount, interval (daily, monthly, total), allowed merchant categories, allowed merchants, allowed countries.
